items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well she had, at that she had made up a band here. We rehearsed a lot there on the ramp.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything more about the Ida Cox troupe? Did she have her whole band with her?

Well she had, at that she had made up a band here. We rehearsed a lot there on the ramp. Right here in town. Ramport in Iran, a place they call the Cotton Club now. At that time we had Bob Ogden, Manuel Cousteau, a boy they call Richard Gray.
